shortDescription: Thailand's electric vehicle board has agreed to increase excise tax on EV imports to promote investment in domestic auto manufacturing, a finance official said on Thursday.A tax rate would be decided the end of the month, Lavaron Sangsnit said.

children: Thailand's electric vehicle board has agreed to increase excise tax on EV imports to promote investment in domestic auto manufacturing, a finance official said on Thursday.
A tax rate would be decided the end of the month, Lavaron Sangsnit said.
